examples.code: Original brief: A repair shop needs a one-page booking site. Primary action: request a repair. Evidence: opening hours and verified customer quotations. Layout: concise introduction, three service cards, pricing explanation, accessible contact form. No autoplay video. At 320px, labels remain visible and actions never overlap.
